name: Reef Shark
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Perception +2. Blindsight 30 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A slender blue-gray shark with a pale underside, pointed snout and swept fins.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 368, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775838-reef-shark
sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The shark has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is free of the Incapacitated condition.
Water Breathing. The shark breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a melee attack roll at +4 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Rhinoceros
otherStatistics: Initiative −1 (9). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A heavy gray rhinoceros with deeply folded skin, stout legs and two nose horns.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 368, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195183-rhinoceros
sections.Actions: Gore. Make a melee attack roll at +7 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the rhinoceros moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage and falls Prone.

name: Riding Horse
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A bay horse with a dark mane, black lower legs and a small white blaze.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 368, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775839-riding-horse
sections.Actions: Hooves. Make a melee attack roll at +5 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency Bonus +2. Perception +5. Stealth +7. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 15. Languages none.
appearance: A muscular tawny cat with spotted flanks, thick forelegs and long upper canines.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 369, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195187-saber-toothed-tiger
sections.Traits: Running Leap. With a 10-ft. running start, the tiger can Long Jump up to 25 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Make a melee attack roll at +6 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.

name: Scorpion
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages none.
appearance: An ochre scorpion with paired pincers and a segmented tail curled over its back.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, p. 369, as credited on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775840-scorpion
sections.Actions: Sting. Make a melee attack roll at +2 with a reach of 5 ft. A hit deals 1 piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
